df = pd.read_excel('/workspace/testbed/data/order_summary.xlsx')

    print(f"  {status}: {count} ({pct:.1f}%)")

print("\\n=== CUSTOMER BREAKDOWN ===")
cust_counts = df['Customer'].value_counts()
print(f"Total unique customers: {cust_counts.shape[0]}")
for cust, count in cust_counts.items():
    total_spent = df[df['Customer'] == cust]['Total Paid'].sum()
    print(f"  {cust}: {count} orders, ${total_spent} total")

print("\\n=== FINANCIAL SUMMARY ===")
total_all = df['Total Paid'].sum()
total_confirmed = df[df['Status'] == 'confirmed']['Total Paid'].sum()
total_cancelled = df[df['Status'] == 'cancelled']['Total Paid'].sum()
print(f"  Grand Total (all orders): ${total_all}")
print(f"  Confirmed orders total:   ${total_confirmed}")
print(f"  Cancelled orders total:   ${total_cancelled}")
print(f"  Average order value:      ${df['Total Paid'].mean():.2f}")
print(f"  Median order value:       ${df['Total Paid'].median():.0f}")

print(f"  Max order value:          ${df['Total Paid'].max()}")
